facts.fact: 前来帮忙的老妇人被废弃犁耙刺穿：钝齿从下巴下方刺入、从左眼穿出。
facts.anchor: One of those blunt fingers enters under her jaw, just behind the chin, and comes out through her left eye, that eye hanging on its stalk by her jaw

facts.fact: 穿秋叶衬衫的皮卡车主（「小丑」）被「你」用木杖刺穿。
facts.anchor: The moment this jester leans back to better see and try to make sense of this dirt bike and your tenuous association with it, rush forward and impale him with the sharp, leading point of your staff

facts.fact: 「你」杀死骑越野车的男孩，并站在一旁听他把生命哭进土里。
facts.anchor: Stand there and listen to him sob his life into the soil.

facts.fact: 「你」绷断铁丝，另一头干净利落地切开女警的喉咙。
facts.anchor: The other end of the wire bisects this officer’s throat so neatly that at first there’s just a red line her hand can clutch up to

facts.fact: 长头发母亲（Mooch）从房车走下来，对着「你」喊「Connie？」——她以为「你」是她儿子 Conrad。
那只橙色斑点充气恐龙突然出现，真正的眼睛藏在脖子处的布面板里——它让「你」退缩。
facts.anchor: Because the real eyes, the eyes trying to spear your chest through, are in a fabric panel hidden in the neck of this speckled, orange abomination

facts.fact: 「你」回想 Carlisle 学校里的男孩们：他们在临终时呼唤母亲，那些从未听过的名字让「你」着迷。
facts.anchor: This is why the boys at the school were so perfect, wasn’t it? They were the teachers, actually, opening up a whole new world of delights for you: each of them wanted their mothers at the end

facts.fact: 骑手站在房车门口盯着「你」，等待「你的下一个特技」；「你」点头承诺会是最精彩的一次。
facts.anchor: He’s waiting for your next stunt, isn’t he?
